title: Foeniculum vulgare essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Foeniculum vulgare essential oil is derived from the flowering top of the fennel plant through steam distillation. It is widely used in herbalism for its digestive, anti-inflammatory, and carminative properties. This essential oil is often employed to alleviate symptoms of indigestion, bloating, and gas by stimulating the digestive system. It can also be used topically to relieve muscle spasms and respiratory congestion. In aromatherapy, it is valued for its warming and uplifting effects on the mind and body.
